title: Day 1 · a Short Rest in room 1.2
headline: Morten takes a Short Rest in the cleared room. Two Hit Dice bring him to 18/20 HP, and Arcane Recovery gives back Magic Missile.

bullets.label: Why here
bullets.text: floor 1 has no wandering monsters, and leaving the floor would end the Delve. Resting in the dog's room costs nothing but the hour.

bullets.label: Hit Dice
bullets.text: two spent, 1d6+2 each: 6 and 4 HP. Morten 8 → 18/20 HP. 1 of 3 Hit Dice left.

bullets.label: Arcane Recovery
bullets.text: Magic Missile is back (level 1 of the 2 levels allowed). The feature is used until the Long Rest.

bullets.label: Still running
bullets.text: Mage Armor until 17:10, the lamp until 15:10. Heroic Inspiration and the potion are both spent.
